entities.summary: The Cherkaskul culture is an archaeological culture of the Bronze Age, situated in the south of the Ural and Western Siberia. It is named after the village Cherkaskul located in the Kaslinsky District of the Chelyabinsk Oblast. Opened K.V.Salnikov in 1964.
